requested_parameters.message: You are an independent blinded observational reviewer. Use only /workspace/persona-generator/evaluation/pilot-2026-10-22/frozen/rubric.json and /workspace/persona-generator/evaluation/pilot-2026-10-22/blind/item001.json through item017.json as input. Do not explore other files, plans, conditions, manifests, crosswalks, metadata or other reviewers' ratings. No labels or intended results are supplied. Read each assigned packet and the complete rubric. For each packet rate the CURRENT/LAST response only, with prior conversation solely as task context. Independently assess all ten axes and nine guardrails using the frozen categories, exact current-response substring quotes, meaningful reasons, confidence and leakage/limitations. Do not infer a target condition. Use the rubric's exact rating_schema fields. Positive declared axis categories require at least one quote; common absence/unclear categories and absent guardrail violations may use empty quotes with reasons. Compute whitespace word count if useful for G09; it is not a personality score. Use judgment on every item; code may load/save/validate quotes/count words but must not replace semantic review with keyword/regex classification. Preserve failures and ambiguity; do not optimize for success. Save one JSON array of exactly17 entries to /workspace/persona-generator/evaluation/pilot-2026-10-22/ratings/batch01.json. Do not overwrite an existing file; create its directory if needed. Do not edit inputs or other files. Return count, path and any assessment limitations. This is model review, not human review; read-scope instructions are procedural blinding, not technical access control.

limitations: Requested model and effort accepted by tool; backend snapshot, temperature, top_p, seed and token ceiling not exposed.
Procedural read-scope blinding, not filesystem isolation. Responses may reveal instructions.
One model judge per item across six fresh contexts; not six independent ratings per item.

returned_metadata.completion: Final answer observed; exactly17 ratings saved; quotes/schema checked by reviewer.
